sections.content: Use egy (a/an) before a noun to name a single object, and drop it when the object already has van (there is/exists).
sections.title: egy + noun

sections.content: egy does double duty: it's 'a/an' in Ez egy asztal (This is a table), but it's also the number 'one' when counting — egy könyv, két könyv (one book, two books).
